result.title: PTQ4SAM3: Semantics-Preserving Post-Training Quantization for Segment Anything Model 3
result.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to WACV 2027. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) can segment objects from text prompts and track them across video, but its memory and computation costs make deployment difficult. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces these costs by using fewer bits. However, a quantized model can select the wrong object or lose track of its target across frames. We call this prompt-alignment drift. Controlled tests show that perturbing low-variance feature directions strongly affects target selection. We propose Semantics-Preserving Quantization (SPQ), which gives more calibration weight to concept-sensitive parameters, preserves residual features, and corrects the mean error in video memory. Fixed text concepts guide calibration without task annotations. All three components operate offline and add no inference operators. With a W4A8 image encoder, SPQ improves RefCOCO Pr@0.5 from 42.1 to 72.5 over PTQ4SAM while retaining 54.8 COCO mask AP. Experiments on LVIS, RefCOCO variants, and SA-V show consistent gains. A CLIP study also shows improved image-text retrieval.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 SAM 3 部署成本高，作者发现扰动低方差特征方向会明显改变文本提示下的目标选择，称其为「提示对齐漂移」，并提出离线语义保持量化 SPQ：给概念敏感参数更高校准权重、保留残差特征、校正视频记忆的均值误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 「低方差方向扰动即改变目标选择」这一诊断可供核查任务必要视觉证据在内部状态中的保留程度与敏感方向，视频记忆的均值误差校正也提示多帧 latent 状态的漂移累积问题，但论文目标为压缩效率而非 LVR 机制。
